name: ShinkaEvolve
reason: Paper verified (arXiv 2509.19349, v1 2025-09-17, not withdrawn). Official Sakana AI repo verified, Apache-2.0, links same arXiv ID, ICLR 2026 acceptance noted on repo. Scope adjudication per slice note: it is a domain-general LLM+evolutionary program-search discovery engine (circle packing SOTA, AIME math, competitive programming, MoE load balancing, Verilog circuit design, numerical solvers) - the open-source analog of the already-cataloged AlphaEvolve, so in-scope as a discovery engine; assigned to crossdomain rather than the discovery lane's 'physics'.

record.name: ShinkaEvolve
record.domain: General program/algorithm discovery: mathematical optimization (circle packing), math reasoning (AIME), competitive programming, LLM training (MoE load balancing), circuit design, numerical methods
record.inputs: Task specification, initial program, and a fitness/evaluation program; runs locally or on Slurm clusters
record.outputs: Evolved programs and solutions, solution archives with island-based knowledge transfer, run monitoring via WebUI
record.notes: Sakana AI's open-source (Apache-2.0) framework using an LLM ensemble as mutation operators over evolving program populations; reported a new state-of-the-art circle-packing solution in ~150 samples. Human gates: the user defines the problem and the evaluation function; the evolutionary loop then closes computationally (no physical loop). ICLR 2026 acceptance noted on the repo.

name: Safe-SDL

name: Agon

In-scope: cross-domain autonomous research orchestrator running scientist-coder-auditor 'Prompt Economy' loops, 444 iterations across 10+ domains (incl. robotics VLA and computational biology case studies) with no human-written experimental code. Full-text HTML names the release repo github.com/AutoResearch-Factory/Agon; GitHub API confirms the repo exists (created 2026-06-18, pushed 2026-08-02, MIT license) and its description matches the paper - author-declared, so ownership stands. Access upgraded from the discovery note's 'no code link' to open-source.
